name: Shima Yukimi
source: Shima is a mysterious girl who spaces out a lot and does not understand feelings since she always has a poker face on. However, if you look closely, there is a feeling on cowlick (apogee). She tends to be seen as a strange girl, but Shima is thoughtful of her friends.
